name: Chat thread
what: A chat that builds message by message: each bubble grows out of its corner, its words fade in a moment later, the replies come after typing dots - green on beige, blue on white or dark.

learned_from.what: the sent bubble, the reply's empty bubble then its words, the times and ticks
left / right bubbles, typing dots before each reply

motion: a bubble every 34 f: back.out 12 f from its corner, the words 8 f later; typing dots 24 f before a reply
